full_page.content:
1936, March
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 101 Cont.
Mar. 24 Maloney ... angry (shell-shocked) with Mrs. McMaster for money borrow- ed of him. She came to St. Anthony's devotion last week and promis- ed 1% of anything she might collect on insurence policy she had ne- glected for years - thought absolutely "dead". Last Friday one of her creditors came to monastery lamenting inability to pay his debts because Mrs. McM. did not pay hers. To-day Mrs. M. comes to say she has received four times the amount of her debts from the Ins. Co .... says ... "Miracle". Deo Gr .!
Page 102
Mar. 24 Mrs. E. Pike - 57 - blind 2 yrs. - convert since 15 - bapt. 18 - Fath- er an honest "Camplelite" - Mother an honest Methodist Christian - both became Catholic and "God Children of their daughter. Daughter had been more or less in love with Catholic doctrine and at 15 decided she would become Catholic even if it were necessary to run away from home .... at 18 she was baptized.
Rose Kastavac - 44 - widow with 6 children. Now two yrs paralyzed can walk only with crutches and very little at that ..... Florence Campbell - tuomer operation set for next Monday Mrs. Florence Price - 43 - once a baptist - husband away with niece ... 27 bad.
Devotion to Sacred Head - leaflets Louise Gehebe - Goitre - going back to specialist this week. .... Nestor & Vincent Law - Employ. ....
Page 103 Mar. 26
Mary Lou Bell - 5 - Enrolled by phone March 11th as against pneumonia & mastoids .... operation at first postponed .... now threatened with 2nd.
Germaine de Backer ... 15 ... Very remarkable mysterious spells, now seven months .... normal whenever the doctor or priest comes .... . Joseph Colwell - 45 - n.c. Wife & 3 child'n - Cath. (cement) con- tractor, has had hardly anything to do for seven yrs. 27 Mr. Michael Fayed - 48 - (Deaconess Hosp'1) Spinal maningitis, & pneumonia - enrolled % phone at about 3 P.M. - at 5:45 Son comes and enrolls him as a perpt'l member. "still unconscious" one whole side paralyzed - hopeless.
